tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Hader Navy, the identity colour. Sidebar, app icon ground, headings, primary structure. As text: on surface-100/200/300 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Present / success and the main action (Save, Start). A fill only: for teal text use teal-ink.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text on a teal fill (4.9:1 light, 7:1 dark).

tokens.name: teal-ink
tokens.usage: Teal as text and icons: on surface-100/200/300 and teal-soft.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a present / connected card or tile.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Late, attention, points and the dot in the mark. A fill only.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on an amber fill. Never white on amber.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text: late times, 'اقترب قليلاً'. On surface-100/200/300 and amber-soft.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a late / pending card.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Absent, disconnected, destructive. Only for states, never decoration. Fill only.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on a red fill.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Red as text and icons, on surface-100/200/300 and red-soft.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an absent / disconnected card.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background, app background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, phone screens.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: chips, selected rows, segmented track, skeletons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders and dividers (decorative, not for controls).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, outline buttons, unchecked toggles (3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on any surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, helper text, meta. On surface-100/200/300.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Welcome screens, splash, empty states. Once per screen.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Card and section titles; phone screen titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: وصل أحمد إلى المدرسة الساعة 7:41 بصمة إصبع.
styles.usage: Default text. Arabic needs the taller 28px leading.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status pills, badges, tiny meta. Never below 12px.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Times, scores and IDs inside Arabic text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, inside compact rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a phone column; tile grid gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (phone), page gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero / welcome spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Key hints, small badges, attendance calendar cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: App tiles (sections, devices), big cards.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon corner on previews (iOS masks the real icon itself).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, chips, notification counts.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers: notification panel, search palette.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: In-app arrival banner.
